findings.confirmed: Manual workflow_dispatch used HF_TOKEN and git push -f to the Hugging Face Space main branch without per-run confirmation.
findings.mitigation: Permissionless fail-closed no-op; the separate sync-huggingface workflow already has explicit YES confirmation and a non-force upload path.

findings.confirmed: Manual workflow issued Hugging Face repository DELETE and POST calls using HF_TOKEN without per-run approval.
findings.mitigation: Permissionless fail-closed no-op. Any future migration requires a separately reviewed plan and explicit authorization.

findings.confirmed: Workflow accepted a Databricks PAT as workflow_dispatch input, passed it to gh secret set, then dispatched deployment. Workflow inputs are not a secret-storage channel and may be visible in run metadata to authorized repository users.
findings.mitigation: Remove the input and disable the workflow. Rotate secrets through the approved secret-management interface; never put PAT values in workflow inputs, comments or command-line arguments.

findings.confirmed: Weekly scheduled workflow held contents:write and committed a metrics JSON file to public main. The script calls GET /products rather than GET /sales and intends product aggregates, but prints the full product response to workflow logs.
findings.mitigation: Disable the scheduled writer pending a privacy-reviewed allowlisted aggregate schema and artifact-only delivery. Do not infer purchaser-level exposure from the inspected products endpoint.

findings.confirmed: Manual workflow had contents:write and pull-requests:write, invoked Groq-assisted code generation, and could create/push a candidate branch and open a PR. Candidate validation includes syntax checking but not the target repository full CI before PR creation. A separate unused CLI mode can push an audit artifact to main if invoked with --persist-audit-report; the inspected workflow does not pass that argument.
findings.mitigation: Require explicit YES for each run, restrict workflow ref to main, checkout main explicitly, retain PR-only candidate generation, and verify the workflow does not invoke direct-main persistence.

findings.confirmed: Manual workflow uploaded a merged model to Hugging Face without explicit confirmation. model_name was interpolated directly into shell commands and mergekit used --trust-remote-code.
findings.mitigation: Require explicit YES, pass destination through an environment variable, validate a restrictive suffix allowlist, remove --trust-remote-code and keep upload in a separately gated job.

findings.confirmed: Duplicate workflow had the same model-upload body and workflow name as barrot-merge.yml.
findings.mitigation: Disable duplicate entry point and direct operators to the single gated workflow.

findings.confirmed: Manual workflow called the Hugging Face factory restart endpoint using HF_TOKEN without explicit per-run confirmation.
findings.mitigation: Require confirm_external_change=YES before the job can read HF_TOKEN or call the restart endpoint.

findings.confirmed: Controlled approval workflow validates PR number, expected head SHA, open state, main base, same-repository origin and reason; it adds an approved label and comment but does not submit a GitHub review or merge.
findings.mitigation: Preserve action but document that label/comment are audit metadata, not a GitHub review or merge authorization.

findings.confirmed: Both workflows require confirm_external_change=YES with default NO and a job-level condition before external mutation.
findings.mitigation: Preserve existing per-run confirmation gates and add regression tests.

verification.source_state: Read-only inspection of public current main and source PR #1620 branch.
verification.proposed_changes: 11 high-risk workflows quarantined in the integrated containment, Cross Analysis retained as read-only/artifact-only, eight residual external-action workflows adjusted, one new regression test plus the existing containment test registered in CI, and two append-only audit artifacts.

next_actions: Verify exact-head CI and fail-closed gate on the fresh-main successor.
Review branch-protection and environment approval settings with authorized repository administration.
Keep external deployment, restart, token rotation and model upload unexecuted until a human approves a specific run.
Revisit Gumroad metrics only after allowlisting output fields, suppressing raw product response logs and switching to artifact-only storage.
